evaluation.justice: Narrow single lane, mixed pedestrian-vehicle traffic, insufficient travel equity guarantee.
evaluation.safety: No guardrails and complete markings, low vehicle speed reduces accident risk.
evaluation.livability: Surrounded by farmland and vegetation, quiet environment but lack of supporting facilities.
evaluation.sustainability: Large surrounding natural vegetation, good ecological background.
evaluation.aesthetics: Plain rural appearance, messy roadside sundries affect visual neatness.
evaluation.comfort: Simple road surface, basic passing comfort.
evaluation.walkability: No dedicated sidewalk, walking mixed with vehicles.
evaluation.bikeability: Narrow road width, basic short-distance riding available.
